slug: 2025-09-18 Ethiopia's approach to their National Data Strategy offers lessons for Africa's digital future

facts.fact: DIAL says Ethiopia is developing its first national data governance strategy, begun under the Office of the Prime Minister with a technical committee from INSA, MiNT, the Ethiopian AI Institute and Addis Ababa University, which produced a draft framework that DIAL helped expand into a full draft strategy reviewed at a workshop.
